encoding: Opaque #rrggbb sRGB colors. Original alpha expressions and compositing choices are retained for One variants.
canonical_policy: Preserve the complete chosen official named palette, including unused colors, aliases and nested namespaces. Keep each iconic canonical background. Menu text may use stronger existing emphasis or a documented Muxe adaptation; upstream_roles records source roles independently. No ANSI-only substitution or port-majority vote.
comparison_policy: Inventory all files in each requested pinned collection and inspect every plausible family candidate, including siblings and forks. comparison_sources stores immutable raw hashes, paths, declared format roles and normalized RGB; variants reference those records and explain identity, exact-value membership and default-role discrepancies. Exact membership is not same-role agreement. Missing candidates and ambiguous names remain explicit. Prior collection snapshots are superseded by the requested revisions.
contrast_policy: Primary text, subdued same-family secondary text and thin structural glyphs must be meaningfully distinct together at actual UI sizes. Muted and separator may not share RGB. Preserve iconic backgrounds and scheme spirit; stronger primary text is allowed when needed to open the neutral ladder. States must have distinct recognizable hues; pending and blocked may not collapse. Prefer existing palette roles, then individually documented adaptations with source inputs and rejected candidates. WCAG2 sRGB contrast and enabled/disabled Chevron badge ratios are diagnostics, not accessibility or visual acceptance gates. Retain accent semantics rather than substitute neutral text to meet one global ratio. Terminal dimming, font rendering and inherited colors require actual renderer proof.
normalization: Hex letter case is normalized without numerical changes. Dracula human-readable row labels use documented snake_case aliases. Nested palette names and array indices use dotted paths. One HSL/Less and alpha normalization is recorded per source expression. NONE/no-color sentinels and non-color metadata are not RGB swatches.

variants.palette_scope: all sixteen absolute Solarized names, identical across light/dark; semantic roles choose the mode
comparison_notes: Retain the 16 official absolute colors. Gogh Builtin normal white/default fg/cursor #b2b8ad matches Base24 base05, not base06 #eee8d5; both are separately recorded roles. iTerm2 dark ANSI white is #eee8d5, light ANSI white #bbb5a2. Do not replace official swatches with port conversions. Patched/Higher Contrast/Darcula/Osaka are derivatives; a conversion mechanism is not established by these files.
See solarized_role_discrepancies for exact official, Gogh Builtin, requested Base24 builtin and iTerm2 role-by-role white/cursor/background interpretation.

semantic_decisions.reason: Use the opposite-surface canonical neutral for menu emphasis, the official default foreground for secondary text, and the next lower-contrast neutral for thin structure. Preserve every absolute Solarized name; do not rename port ANSI white or use the low-visibility base01/base1 secondary proposal.
Keep the selected canonical base3 #fdf6e3 surface; terminal bg_dim choices and sibling variants do not override it.

Use the opposite-surface canonical neutral for menu emphasis, the official default foreground for secondary text, and the next lower-contrast neutral for thin structure. Preserve every absolute Solarized name; do not rename port ANSI white or use the low-visibility base01/base1 secondary proposal.
Use the canonical blue accent for keys in both modes; keep its measured contrast rather than substitute a neutral.

Use the opposite-surface canonical neutral for menu emphasis, the official default foreground for secondary text, and the next lower-contrast neutral for thin structure. Preserve every absolute Solarized name; do not rename port ANSI white or use the low-visibility base01/base1 secondary proposal.
Use a canonical red or rose for errors; retain the semantic hue even when its contrast is below the normal-text reference.
Use the canonical yellow or golden accent for waiting states.
Use the canonical orange or warm warning accent rather than neutral text or the error red.
Use the canonical green for reloads rather than an informational blue or neutral fallback.
Use a canonical cyan or blue for information; sharing the key accent is intentional where it limits unnecessary hues.

contrast.method: WCAG2 sRGB relative luminance; (Lmax+0.05)/(Lmin+0.05), no alpha or terminal dimming

semantic_decisions.reason: Use stronger same-tint ink, official fg as secondary, and green-grey grey2 for structures; no background alteration.
Keep the selected canonical bg0 #fdf6e3 surface; terminal bg_dim choices and sibling variants do not override it.
Use stronger same-tint ink, official fg as secondary, and green-grey grey2 for structures; no background alteration.
Use the source blue accent for actionable keys, also shared by informational notices.
Use stronger same-tint ink, official fg as secondary, and green-grey grey2 for structures; no background alteration.
Use a canonical red or rose for errors; retain the semantic hue even when its contrast is below the normal-text reference.
Use the canonical yellow or golden accent for waiting states.
Use the canonical orange or warm warning accent rather than neutral text or the error red.
Use the canonical green for reloads rather than an informational blue or neutral fallback.
Use a canonical cyan or blue for information; sharing the key accent is intentional where it limits unnecessary hues.

contrast.method: WCAG2 sRGB relative luminance; (Lmax+0.05)/(Lmin+0.05), no alpha or terminal dimming

mono-2: would collapse structure into secondary labels

solarized_role_discrepancies.absolute_names: Official dark macros define the absolute palette. The commented light macros swap the neutral meanings; Muxe retains absolute color names in both schemes.

official_light.ansi_white: absolute base02 #073642 via commented light macro remap
official_light.ansi_bright_white: absolute base03 #002b36 via commented light macro remap

gogh_builtin.selection: not declared in these two files

base24_builtin.cursor_selection: not declared by these Base24 palette files
base24_builtin.decision: Gogh normal white/default foreground agrees with Base24 default foreground, not Base24 base06. Base24 slots are not absolute Solarized names.

solarized_role_discrepancies.iterm2: Kitty and Ghostty iTerm2 Solarized Dark default foreground #839496, normal white #eee8d5, bright white #fdf6e3. Their Light foreground #657b83, normal white #bbb5a2 and bright white #fdf6e3 are terminal mappings, not the commented official light ANSI remap. All cursor/selection tokens remain independently recorded in comparison_sources.
solarized_role_discrepancies.conversion_limit: The pinned files establish different values and roles, not a unique historical conversion algorithm. Do not describe unexplained differences as a proved gamma conversion.
solarized_role_discrepancies.menu_decision: Dark uses a separately documented same-tint emphasis derived from official base0, then unchanged base0 secondary text and base00 structure. Warm base2 remains available as canonical ANSI white, not primary menu text. Light uses base02 / base00 / base0. These are menu-role adaptations, not upstream default-foreground claims.
